title: pvResourceTransferFunction2D
body:
## pvResourceTransferFunction2D

Typed two-dimensional transfer-function resource (vtkPVTransferFunction2D): colour and opacity defined over two axes, usually a scalar on x and a second quantity such as gradient magnitude on y, as used by ParaView's 2-D volume rendering. It is built from coloured rectangles (Boxes) within Range and sampled to an image of OutputDimensions. In Schemaxis it only connects to the TransferFunction2D input of pvResourcePVLookupTable; Schemaxis scene appearances do not perform volume rendering.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Creating it has no visible effect in Schemaxis images; it is relevant only if a consumer uses the lookup table's 2-D function.
- Exercised by examples/schemaxis/paraview-resources.json (verification/2026-09-16-catalogue-expansion.json); its rendering effect is unverified.

Native constructor: `TransferFunction2D`. Identity: `transfer_2d_functions/TransferFunction2D`. Role: `resource`. Output kinds: `["transfer-function-2d"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AutomaticRescaleRangeMode` | Choose whether and how to automatically rescale the color map range. "Never" means the color map range will never be changed. "Grow and update on 'Apply'" will expand the range to contain the union of the current range and the range of the current data source. "Grow and update every timestep" will expand the range to contain the union of the current range and the range of the current data source when the timestep is changed. "Clamp and update every timestep" will update the color map range to the current source data range. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Never","Grow and update on 'Apply'","Grow and update every timestep","Update on 'Apply'","Clamp and update every timestep"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Never"` |
| `Boxes` | Specify the box parameters for the 2D transfer function. These are a list of 8-tuples of the form (x, y, width, height, r, g, b, a) where (x, y) is the position i.e. the range-min of the box, (width, height) specify the dimensions of the box in the scalar units and (r, g, b, a) denote the color with maximum alpha of the box. The color and alpha components are in the range [0, 1]. Complete tuples of 8 values. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1]` |
| `OutputDimensions` | The dimensions of the image that represents this 2D transfer function. | `{"items":{"type":"integer"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1]` |
| `Range` | The range of the X and Y axes of the transfer function. This is specified as a 4-tuple of the form (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax). | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":4,"minItems":4,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1,1]` |
| `ScalarRangeInitialized` | Set to 1 to indicate that the scalar range has been initialized. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
